elements.text:
Your teacher tells your class that tomorrow you'll divide into small groups to discuss the book you're reading. She also says that you'll have to pick your group, but you realize you don't have any close friends in the class. 

Here are some behaviors that someone might do at that moment or in the future:

texts: I'll go to the bathroom so that I don't have to ask anyone to be in their group.
I'll want to say I want to work alone, but give the group a try.
I want to stay quiet, but decide to contribute.
I will talk to people in class and ask to be in a group.
I'll find a few other people who don't have a group and make one with them.
